what.text: The number of other people in need of international protection from Venezuela in Argentina reached 174216 at the end of 2025.
In 2025, Argentina hosted 2.9 percent of all Venezuelan people in need of international protection.
Refugees from Venezuela also live in host countries including Spain, Brazil, United States, Mexico, and Costa Rica.

why.text: The dataset does not list specific active conflicts or dated events to explain the causes of Venezuelan displacement.
Although internal displacement figures from disasters are tracked, no specific disaster hazard types are recorded in the provided sources.

when.text: The count of other people in need of international protection from Venezuela in Argentina was 127152 at the end of 2018.
This population grew over the following years to reach a peak of 215541 at the end of 2023.
During the same timeframe, asylum seeker totals in Argentina peaked in 2021 before falling by the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people used to travel or how they live in Argentina.
Counts for refugees, asylum seekers, and other people in need of international protection represent year-end totals on 31 December.
Internal disaster displacement metrics count movements during each year rather than individual people.
